# Verba School

> Online language school in Armenia (verba-school.online). Spanish, English and French lessons from A1 to C1 (CEFR), taught with explanations in Armenian. Lessons are online, in a group or one-on-one. Group lessons 25,000 AMD/month, private lessons 30,000 AMD/month. Certificate at the end of the course. Contact: Instagram @verba.school_, phone +374 77 30 85 25.

Verba School (Armenian: Վերբա) explains grammar in Armenian and builds listening and speaking with real texts. Lessons follow the European language levels (CEFR); at the end of each level a test shows whether the student is ready for the next one.
All lessons are online, in a group or one-on-one. Students get personal links to listening tasks, level tests and online lessons.
The website is in Armenian (main), Russian and English, with a Spanish home page.

## Courses
- [Spanish lessons online](https://verba-school.online/en/spanish/): Spanish from beginner to advanced. Armenian: https://verba-school.online/ispaneren/ · Russian: https://verba-school.online/ru/ispanskiy/
- [English lessons online](https://verba-school.online/en/english/): English from beginner to advanced. Armenian: https://verba-school.online/angleren/ · Russian: https://verba-school.online/ru/angliyskiy/
- [French lessons online](https://verba-school.online/en/french/): French from beginner to advanced. Armenian: https://verba-school.online/franseren/ · Russian: https://verba-school.online/ru/francuzskiy/

## Free level tests
- [Free Spanish level test](https://verba-school.online/en/test/spanish/): 20 questions, about 10 minutes, result from A1 to C1.
- [Free English level test](https://verba-school.online/en/test/english/): 20 questions, about 10 minutes, result from A1 to C1.
- [Free French level test](https://verba-school.online/en/test/french/): 20 questions, about 10 minutes, result from A1 to C1.

## Prices and offers
- Group lessons: 25,000 AMD per month.
- Private (one-to-one) lessons: 30,000 AMD per month.
- [Bring a friend](https://verba-school.online/en/refer-a-friend/): the friend gets 10% off their first month, the student who invited them gets 5,000 AMD.

## Frequently asked questions
### What is Verba School?
Verba School is an online language school in Armenia. We teach Spanish, English and French from A1 to C1, with explanations in Armenian.

### How do the lessons work?
All lessons are online, in a group or one-on-one, so you learn from home without wasting time on the road. Students get personal links to listening tasks, level tests and online lessons.

### How much do lessons cost?
Group lessons are 25,000 AMD a month and private lessons are 30,000 AMD a month.

### How do I find my level?
Take our [free online level test](https://verba-school.online/en/test/english/): 20 questions, about 10 minutes. Your teacher confirms your level in the first lesson.

### Do you give a certificate?
Yes, you get a certificate when you finish the course.

### Are there discounts?
If a friend signs up with your code, they get 10% off their first month and you get 5,000 AMD. See [Bring a friend](https://verba-school.online/en/refer-a-friend/).

### How do I sign up?
Message us on Instagram at [@verba.school_](https://www.instagram.com/verba.school_/) or call [+374 77 30 85 25](tel:+37477308525).

- [How long does it take to learn a foreign language?](https://verba-school.online/en/blog/how-long-to-learn-a-language/): It's the most common question. There's no exact answer, but there are realistic numbers to help you plan.
- [Spanish or French: which should you choose?](https://verba-school.online/en/blog/spanish-or-french/): Both are beautiful Romance languages with shared roots, but learning them feels quite different.
